title: Paperclip auth path unavailable in Cursor Cloud
summary: The shell can modify the Git repo but cannot update the assigned Paperclip issue without control-plane auth.

payload.title: Which auth path should Prometheus use for Paperclip issue updates?

questions.label: Choose the unblock path
questions.helpText: Inject PAPERCLIP_API_KEY into the Cursor Cloud adapter env, or provide another supported control-plane auth path.
